story.title: Three decades pursuing a single uncompromising standard.
story.desc1: Founded in the heart of Italy's industrial valley, PITEX began as a small precision tooling workshop with a single conviction: that olive oil production deserves the same engineering rigor as any high-performance machine. That conviction has since carried us into 42 countries, working alongside the world's most demanding producers.
story.desc2: Today, we sit at the intersection of traditional craftsmanship and Industry 4.0 — designing, manufacturing and commissioning turnkey extraction systems engineered for maximum yield, uncompromising quality, and decades of reliable operation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Straight answers to the questions clients ask most before committing to a production line — from customization and certification to installation and ongoing support.
faq.supportText: Can’t find what you’re looking for? Our engineering team is ready to walk through your project’s technical specifics.

turnkey.q: Do you provide turnkey olive oil production lines?
turnkey.a: Yes. We design, manufacture and commission complete turnkey lines — from fruit reception through extraction, separation and storage — engineered and delivered as a single integrated system rather than assembled components.

customized.a: Every line starts from your throughput, fruit variety and footprint. Our engineers adapt capacity, automation level and layout so the finished system integrates cleanly with your existing facility.

certifications.q: What certifications do your production lines meet?
certifications.a: All PITEX lines are engineered under ISO 9001:2015 quality management and meet CE machinery safety directives, with food-contact materials certified for direct edible oil handling.

installation.q: How do you handle installation and commissioning?
installation.a: A dedicated engineering crew manages on-site installation, calibration and commissioning, then trains your operators before final sign-off — so the line runs at full capacity from day one.
